data.yaml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 10s
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
runtime:
  gogc: 75
  log_level: info
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
  - follow_redirects: true
    enable_http2: true
    scheme: http
    timeout: 10s
    api_version: v2
    static_configs:
    - targets:
      - alertmanager:9093
rule_files:
- /etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- job_name: node
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - node-exporter:9100
    labels:
      env: dev
- job_name: alertmanager
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - alertmanager:9093
- job_name: loki
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - loki:3100
- job_name: tempo
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - tempo:3200
- job_name: down
  honor_timestamps: true
  track_timestamps_staleness: false
  scrape_interval: 10s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  scrape_protocols:
  - OpenMetricsText1.0.0
  - OpenMetricsText0.0.1
  - PrometheusText1.0.0
  - PrometheusText0.0.4
  scrape_native_histograms: false
  always_scrape_classic_histograms: false
  convert_classic_histograms_to_nhcb: false
  metrics_path: /metrics
  scheme: http
  enable_compression: true
  metric_name_validation_scheme: utf8
  metric_name_escaping_scheme: allow-utf-8
  extra_scrape_metrics: false
  follow_redirects: true
  enable_http2: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - node-exporter:9999
storage:
  tsdb:
    outofordertimewindow: 0
    retention:
      time: 2d
  exemplars:
    max_exemplars: 100000
otlp:
  translation_strategy: UnderscoreEscapingWithSuffixes
  label_name_underscore_sanitization: true
  label_name_preserve_multiple_underscores: true
